payload.summary: CME phone customise screen renders two cme-module-order lists, failing the ui-cme-phone reorder-controls browser test
payload.detail: Seen 2026-09-27 in a local full verify:phone-chrome run on PR #3145's branch (which does not touch CME): tests/ui-cme-phone.spec.ts:109 failed with a strict-mode violation, getByTestId('cme-module-order') resolved to 2 elements (one inside mobile-composer-reserve-pad, one elsewhere). Either the customise list is rendered twice on a phone (a real duplicate-controls defect) or the test needs scoping. Not yet diagnosed; check whether it reproduces on origin/main first.
payload.source: Claude Code session 2026-09-27, local verify:phone-chrome (PR #3145 branch)
